headlines.title: Here’s How Intermodal Demand Is Positioning CSX Corp. (CSX) for Growth
headlines.summary: CSX Corp (NASDAQ:CSX) reported better-than-expected results for the second quarter of 2026, thanks to strong intermodal demand. More containers moved by rail rather than truck, along with steady pricing, which helped CSX reach a record revenue of $3.94 billion.

headlines.title: Hedge Funds Favor Union Pacific Corporation (UNP) Over Canadian Pacific (CP): UNP Beat Earnings and Just Got a Major Win
headlines.summary: Union Pacific Corporation (NYSE:UNP)’s Big Boy 4014, the world’s largest operating steam locomotive, has been touring the country this summer, and grown adults keep tearing up when they see it.

description: Union Pacific Corporation, through its subsidiary, Union Pacific Railroad Company, operates in the railroad business in the United States. It offers transportation services for grain and grain products, fertilizers, food and refrigerated products, and coal and renewables to grain processors, animal feeders, and ethanol and renewable biofuel producers; and construction products, industrial chemicals, plastics, forest products, specialized products, metals and ores, petroleum, liquid petroleum gases, soda ash, and sand, as well as finished automobiles, automotive parts, and merchandise in intermodal containers. The company was founded in 1862 and is headquartered in Omaha, Nebraska.
